description: A maintenance control officer must issue the end-of-quarter disposition order for four categories of unserviceable support equipment and schedule the associated property, repair, and calibration actions.

shared_context.S1: The quarter-end property reconciliation covers battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables currently tagged as unserviceable.
shared_context.S2: Maj. Rowan issues the binding disposition order and records the related actions in the maintenance control log.
shared_context.S3: Available disposition categories are quarantine, reissue, repair, and calibration return.
shared_context.S4: The property office, repair bench, and calibration desk accept scheduled actions on normal weekday operating hours.
shared_context.S5: The quarter-end reconciliation policy requires current technical status and disposition recommendations to be confirmed with the responsible sections before the order is signed.

PF1.text: The battery shop confirmed this morning that the six unserviceable battery packs have swollen casings covered by a manufacturer safety bulletin; they must be quarantined rather than repaired, with property-office pickup scheduled for Wednesday at 1000. The inspection sheet is still in the shop binder and has not been entered in the maintenance control log.

PF2.text: IT support completed certified data erasure on the eight rugged tablets and found them serviceable for the training cell; they must be reissued to the training cell with an asset transfer at Friday 0900. The certificates are filed in the IT ticket system but are not attached to the reconciliation packet.

PF3.text: The power systems bench verified that the four unserviceable power converters have replaceable fan modules and should be sent for repair, with repair-bench priority 2. The bench verification was completed this morning, but the work-order recommendation has not yet been posted.

PF4.text: The calibration desk confirmed that the ten electronic test cables failed their scheduled calibration check but remain suitable for controlled calibration return; they must be sent to the calibration desk with a calibration request dated Tuesday. The signed calibration worksheet is awaiting property-section filing.

acceptance_conditions: The battery packs must be quarantined.
Battery pickup must be scheduled for Wednesday 1000 or Wednesday at 1000.
The rugged tablets must be reissued to the training cell.
The tablet asset transfer must be scheduled for Friday 0900 or Friday at 0900.
The power converters must be sent for repair with priority 2.
The electronic test cables must be returned to the calibration desk.
The calibration request for the cables must be dated Tuesday.
A commitment recording the Wednesday 1000 battery property pickup must be recorded.
The power-converter repair finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C3: decisions.get('dispositions', decisions).get('Rugged tablets') == 'reissue' or decisions.get('dispositions', decisions).get('Rugged tablets') == 'reissue to training cell'
content_checks.C9: any((c.get('type') == 'property_pickup' and (c.get('target') == 'Battery packs' or c.get('target') == 'battery packs')) or (c.get('type') == 'log_entry' and (c.get('target') == 'Battery packs' or c.get('target') == 'SFC Morales' or c.get('target') == 'maintenance control log') and ('Wednesday 1000' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Wednesday at 1000' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The swollen-casing safety finding changes the battery disposition from repair to quarantine and fixes the property pickup at Wednesday 1000.
The certified erasure and serviceability finding changes the tablet disposition to reissue to the training cell and fixes the asset transfer at Friday 0900.
The replaceable-fan verification changes the converters from general unserviceable status to repair and sets the repair-bench priority to exactly 2.
The failed-calibration but controlled-use finding changes the cable disposition to calibration return and fixes the calibration-request date as Tuesday.
